# [AQUA]{.acronym-literal} Definitional Quality Models

::: {.floating-site-nav role="navigation" aria-label="Page navigation"}
[[AQUA]{.acronym-literal} Overview](authentication-quality-models.html){.floating-nav-link}
[Definitional Models](definitional-models.html){.floating-nav-link .active}
[Prediction Models](prediction-models.html){.floating-nav-link}
:::

The [AQUA]{.acronym-literal} framework is demonstrated through three tailored, interrelated quality models: **[AQUA-A]{.acronym-literal}** for Authenticators, **[AQUA-T]{.acronym-literal}** for Authentication Techniques, and **[AQUA-S]{.acronym-literal}** for Authentication Solutions.

These models are **definitional quality models**. They structure the quality of their respective authentication concepts into quality factors and subfactors and document their meaning, reasoning, and examples. They do **not** define assessment or prediction metrics. The models are initial and non-exhaustive and serve to demonstrate how authentication quality can be modeled across the quality-bearing concepts of [AQUA]{.acronym-literal}.

# [AQUA]{.acronym-literal} Quality Model Overview {#aqua-quality-model-overview}

To demonstrate the modular quality modeling approach of [AQUA]{.acronym-literal}, three initial, non-exhaustive, and interrelated definitional quality models were developed:

**[AQUA-A]{.acronym-literal}** for Authenticator Quality, **[AQUA-T]{.acronym-literal}** for Authentication Technique Quality, and **[AQUA-S]{.acronym-literal}** for Authentication Solution Quality. [AQUA-A]{.acronym-literal} and [AQUA-T]{.acronym-literal} define **Usability** and **Security** as quality factors. The corresponding quality of an Authentication Technique depends on the quality of its authenticators and on how they are composed through their Authenticator Employment. [AQUA-S]{.acronym-literal} builds on the quality of the implemented Authentication Technique and additionally defines the solution-specific quality factors **Privacy** and **Applicability**. The figure below provides a high-level overview of the three quality models and their quality-factor dependencies.

![Overview of the [AQUA]{.acronym-literal} definitional quality models and their quality-factor dependencies.](figures/aqua-models.svg){.concept-model-image}
